A song for a duck called Gerald.
Shh, he's my biggest fan.
Sometimes there's one extra star by the oak. It flickers green!
Good morning! The snow is white! And Gus is grumpy, right!
(Gus: "I HEARD THAT!")
Good morning! The sun is bright! And Gus is sunburnt white!
(Gus: "THAT DOESN'T EVEN RHYME!")
Good morning! The leaves are gold! And Gus is being cold!
(Gus: "I HEARD THAT!")
Good morning! Blossom on the trees! And Gus is going to sneeze!
(Gus: "I HEARD THAT! ...ACHOO!")
